g.text: Background runs, checkpoints, recovery, and tests
Runs execute as in-process tasks on one instance. Population and social runs checkpoint their work.
resume: population or social run with a checkpoint
Every queued or running run becomes failed with RUN_INTERRUPTED. Population and social runs
with a checkpoint keep their saved work linked and can be resumed.
A queued run is cancelled at once. A running standard run's task is cancelled. Population and social
runs stop after the next checkpoint save and keep their saved work.
PopulationBuilt once, InterviewBatch per batch, SocialRound per round. Each save is idempotent by
index and updates Run.progress; a pending cancel raises RunCancelled after the save.
MAX_ACTIVE_RUNS_PER_USER active runs per user (429 RATE_LIMITED); 4 concurrent runs per
process; timeouts of 15 minutes, or 60 for population and social runs; 5 s task grace on shutdown.
A sleeping or restarted instance loses in-process tasks; the startup sweep records them instead of
agents, analytics, embeddings, llm, qloo, retrieval, vision,
endpoints, demo journey, ownership, runs, persistence; ASGI
openapi.json is current; fixtures validate against the schemas
CORS, error hygiene, prompt injection, secrets, settings guard,
migrations and RLS on a disposable server, enabled by
npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run build
Playwright in e2e/ against a running frontend and backend
fake providers and fixtures; no paid API call in the default test
